'''Rimble-wine''' was a type of rare, vintage [[Wine/Legends|wine]].<ref name="MJH" /> It was expensive,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|101|rimble-wine}}</ref> a single bottle was worth a thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The favorite [[Kaird's aunt|aunt]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Kaird]] once told him a traders story: if you have the only case of rimble-wine available, drink all but one of the bottles. This would ensure that someone would buy the last remaining bottle for the chance of having something unique. The payment for the single bottle would supposedly be worth more than the entire case.<ref name="MJH" />
